scope: Controlled stone fixture, unskipped ground-to-air transitions; no external forces. Read-only telemetry.
method: Horizontal displacement in jump tick minus prior native horizontal velocity. This includes movement acceleration and jump impulse, not an instantaneous sprint flag.
observation: Jump method applies horizontal .2 impulse when aw() sprinting is true. Observed launch increment .306-.327 exceeds normal .13 ground acceleration in these fixtures, consistent with sprint jump even where first-air flag already false. Do not claim all native sprint flags were true.
